transformation: Reshaped paired celldens_dN and pH_dN columns to one row per source experiment/funnel and detected day N. Metadata labels were retained unchanged.

units.Cell_Density: 10^6 cells/mL, as documented in the workbook info sheet
units.pH: pH, as documented in the workbook info sheet
units.Day: Integer day index parsed from source column suffix; day 0 is the source d0 measurement.
units.CO2: Original categorical treatment label; no numeric conversion performed.

missing_value_handling: Missing daily measurements were preserved as null/NaN. No imputation, filling, interpolation, zero replacement, or observation removal was performed.
date_time_transformation: None; the source provides integer day indices, not calendar timestamps.
assumptions: Exp and Funnel# together identify each source culture record; uniqueness is validated.
Matching celldens_dN and pH_dN suffixes refer to the same source day.
